operations.description: Identifies `agentsocks gateway public`, which starts a second listener for ChatGPT, Grok and other remote clients that authenticate with a bearer token or OAuth. The receiving agent reads the text through its own inbox, and a message cannot approve a permission prompt. operations.description: Identifies `agi-memory delete <id> --hard`, which permanently removes an observation rather than marking it superseded. Delete invocations carrying unresolved shell expansions are still reviewed through Guar…

operations.description: Identifies `agi-memory sync dedupe`, which rewrites the canonical append-only memory vault in place. It is the only agi-memory operation that rewrites rather than appends, it prunes records it judges redundant, and a similarity key that merges two distinct memories destroys the loser with no undo. Sync invocations carrying unresolved shell expansions are still reviewed through Guard's floor becau…
